sentences.text:
In the matter of : Abdul Farak Gayen & Ors.
 ....Appellants  Mr. Madhusudan Sur,
 Mr. Dipankar Mahata,
 ....For the State  1.
None appears on behalf of the appellants.

3. This instant appeal is preferred by the appellants against the judgment and order of conviction dated 21.03.2016 and 22.03.2016 wherein these appellants were convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/34 and under Sections 306/34 of the Indian Penal Code and was sentenced to suffer Rigorous Imprisonment for two years along with fine for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/34 and these appellants also sentenced to suffer Rigorous Imprisonment for five years along with fine for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 306/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
4.
An application for bail and suspension of sentence was taken out at the behest of the appellants/convicts but that prayer was rejected by the Court by passing an order dated 20.09.2016.
5. State is directed to obtain a report from the concerned correctional home as to whether these appellants have already served out the sentenced or not and submit report on the next date fixed.
6. Let the matter appear in the list on 22nd May, 2025.

(Prasenjit Biswas, J.)
